subject: SIG orientation + prefill & encryption boundary questions (MedPlatform)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@medplatform.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG orientation + prefill & encryption boundary questions (MedPlatform)

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can get procurement/security moving: 

Recap (from today's discovery)
- MedPlatform is evaluating Redwood for in-app summarization + clinical insights; primary concern is PHI handling and encryption.
- Compliance: you mentioned SOC 2 in progress (expected report Q3) and active HIPAA dataplane controls.
- Residency: US multi-region, with preference for dedicated VPC for production.

Immediate asks / clarifying questions
1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether you have a SOC 2 Type II in progress or a Type I summary? Any expected delivery window (month/quarter) is helpful.
2) Data classification: are the records we would ingest considered PHI under your internal policy? (we can treat as PHI by default if helpful)
3) Encryption & KMS: do you require customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for production? If yes, which cloud provider?
4) SIG vs CAIQ: do you want us to start a SIG prefilling (we can prefill common vendor responses) or would you prefer to complete your CAIQ? We can do either; prefilling usually speeds procurement.

Attachments: I attached a blank SIG prefill template (MedPlatform_SIG_PREFILL.xlsx) to make it easy to capture answers.

Proposed next steps
- If you want us to prefill, approve and return the attached sheet and we'll submit to your security team.
- If you prefer CAIQ, share the deck and we’ll route to our security ops.
- I'll loop in our security engineer for a short technical call if you want a deeper dataflow walk-through.

Thanks — available for a quick follow-up Thursday or Friday afternoon PT.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: MedPlatform_SIG_PREFILL.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Elena Park <elena.park@medplatform.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@medplatform.com
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG orientation + prefill & encryption boundary questions (MedPlatform)

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the recap. A few quick answers below and I've attached a short SOC2 summary we keep for vendors.

SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type I in 2025 and our Type II run is in progress; target delivery is late Q3 2026. The attached PDF is an executive summary we can share with prospective vendors now.

PHI: Yes, the dataset in scope is PHI (clinical notes + identifiers). We'll treat any vendor integration as HIPAA-coverable.

KMS: Production requires customer-managed keys (AWS KMS); sandbox/proof-of-concept can use provider-managed keys.

SIG vs CAIQ: Security team prefers a SIG prefill first, then a CAIQ if there are remaining gaps. Please go ahead and prefill the SIG template — we'll assign a primary reviewer on our side (security@medplatform.com).

Availability: We can do a 30-min technical sync next Tuesday (06/09) at 11:00 PT if that works — please send a calendar invite.

Best,
Elena Park
Senior Procurement Manager, MedPlatform
elena.park@medplatform.com

Attachment: MedPlatform_SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@medplatform.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 12:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG orientation + prefill & encryption boundary questions (MedPlatform)

Thanks Elena — great, we'll proceed with a SIG prefill. A couple of quick technical clarifications for the prefill and the sync: 

1) Encryption at rest: when you say AWS KMS customer-managed, do you require a dedicated AWS account or will a customer key in your account be sufficient?
2) Network boundary: for production do you require a Private Deployment (VPC/on-prem) immediately, or is Dedicated (Redwood Dedicated) acceptable as long as it's in a customer-dedicated VPC peering arrangement?
3) SIEM / logging: do you have a preferred SIEM vendor for log ingestion (Splunk/Datadog/etc.) or do you want us to provide log export examples first?

Connor — can you pick up the prefill draft and start mapping answers to the attached Redwood template? I'm copying a templated prefill (Redwood_SIG_Prefill_Template.xlsx) to keep formatting consistent with our security team.

Elena — we'll send the prefill back for your security reviewer in ~48 hours and put the 06/09 slot on the calendar pending your confirm.

Cheers,
Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Prefill_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG orientation + prefill & encryption boundary questions (MedPlatform)

Perfect — thanks for the fast turnaround, Elena. Confirming next actions: 
- Connor will push the prefill draft to you by end of day Friday (06/05).
- Security reviewer (security@medplatform.com) to review and flag any open items; Marissa will own follow-ups.
- I'll create a HubSpot task for procurement and add the 06/09 technical sync: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/MP-2026-048 (invite pending).

If the SOC 2 Type II comes in earlier than Q3, that will accelerate a blockers list. We'll keep the CAIQ in our back pocket in case your team wants more detail after the SIG.

Thanks again — talk next week.
